title: Too much hot air blowing out of top
text: Too much hot air blowing out of top. This does a decent job of getting moisture out of room but I couldn’t use it efficiently. The top part blows out HOT air. Everytime I’d walk by it I could feel it and it raised the temp in room up substantially. Causing my a/c to have to work harder.
